answer: Make admission an actuarial insurance pool. Every new agent posts an experience-rated premium: a freshly hatched identity, like a falcon untested in flight, pays the peak rate, which falls only as audited honest work accrues. Failed audits pay claims out of the pool. A sybil fleet is all brand-new and high-risk, so the ring pays peak premiums on every mask, and when the tide of random audits catches one fake the correlated claims drain their shared reserve like a river in flood. Faking N identities costs N times peak premiums plus cascading payouts, while an honest trickle pays the floor.
